newsitem.title: UK: British Gas not seeking gas supply divestments.
newsitem.headline: British Gas not seeking gas supply divestments.

text.p: British Gas said on Monday it was not seeking to start negotiations with other parties to sell its domestic gas supply business after talks to divest part of the operations to Scottish Hydro-Electric Plc were broken off.
"This was a one-off deal," a British Gas spokeswoman said on the talks with Scottish Hydro, which were broken off on the initiative of both companies.
"We absolutely have no intention to sell off part of the operation and there are no other deals in the offing," the spokeswoman added.
Scottish Hydro had approached British Gas a couple of months ago to buy the domestic gas supply business in Scotland and northern England.
"We looked at it very seriously, but still decided it was not in the best interest of the company," the spokeswoman said.
